crossRefs.note: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail. This woman was intelligent and had a beautiful…
Then Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves of bread, two containers of wine, five sheep ready dressed, five seahs…
Abigail hurried, and arose, and rode on a donkey, with five ladies of hers who followed her; and she went after the…
David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they both became his wives.
David’s two wives were taken captive, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

parallels.note: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

people.name: Abigail
people.line: Wife of Nabal, later married David

people.name: Achish
people.line: Philistine king of Gath, gave refuge to David

people.name: Ahinoam
people.line: Wife of David, from Jezreel; mother of Amnon

people.name: Carmel
people.line: Town in Judah; home of Nabal and Abigail

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Gath
people.line: Philistine city; home of Goliath; refuge for David

people.name: Jezreel
people.line: A town in Judah, home of David's wife Ahinoam

people.name: Nabal
people.line: Wealthy Carmelite; husband of Abigail. He was known for foolishness.

translations.web: David lived with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal’s wife.
translations.bsb: David and his men settled in Gath with Achish. Each man had his family with him, and David had his two wives: Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail of Carmel, the widow of Nabal.
translations.kjv: And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal's wife.
translations.asv: And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal's wife.
